newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares rise on international trends, Astra.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares rise on international trends, Astra.

text.p: Swedish shares rebounded on Monday, lifted by favourable international trends and a rally in heavyweight pharmaceutical company Astra.
The exchange's general index rose 1.06 percent to 2311.49 in turnover of 3.82 billion crowns after having been depressed by U.S. Federal Reserve's chairman Alan Greenspan's comments on Friday.

Astra was again lifted by persistent rumours that Swiss rival Roche will place a takeover bid on the company, but analysts disagreed about how plausible a takeover or merger would be. The share leapt 13 crowns to 345 crowns.
"These rumours about Roche are very persistent and it is beginning to become difficult to dismiss them now," a trader said.
But pharmaceutical shares also benefited from strong performance by their U.S. counterparts in early overseas trade on Monday. Pharmacia & Upjohn rose seven to 266.5 crowns.
Furthermore, Astra helped investment company Investor, which owns a large Astra stake, up 3.5 crowns to 286.5 crowns.
Telecommunications group Ericsson also recovered, up 2.5 crowns to 201.5 crowns.
